title: Caught up in the herd’s excitement
literal_meaning: When the herd gets excited, even its weak animal gets excited.
meaning_odia: ଗୋଠ ମାତିଲେ ସେଥିରେ ଥିବା ଦୁର୍ବଳ ପଶୁଟି ମଧ୍ୟ ମାତିଉଠେ। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଅନୁସାରେ ଦଳର ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ଉତ୍ସାହରେ ନିଜେ କମ୍ ସମର୍ଥ ଥିବା ଜଣେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସାମିଲ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ଦଳର ଆବେଗ ଜଣକଠାରୁ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କୁ ବ୍ୟାପିବାର ଛବି ଏଠାରେ ଅଛି।
explanation: The herd’s excitement carries even its weaker member along. The inspected gloss applies this to members of a group who become animated with the others despite having less strength or ability on their own. The focus is the spread of collective excitement.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A usually hesitant participant joins in when a whole group grows enthusiastic about a performance. A reader recalls the herd image to describe being swept up in a shared mood.
cultural_context: The same verb frames the herd and its singled-out member, showing the group’s mood repeated in the individual. The public counterpart adds ହଡ଼ା, an old bullock, beside ଖଣ୍ଡିଆ. That supports the contrast with a less vigorous animal without requiring an invented injury.

witnesses.locator: Page15, opening line beginning ଗୋଠ ମାତିଲେ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact short wording retained.
Public counterpart adds parenthetic ହଡ଼ା and plural/respectful ମାତନ୍ତି. Gloss explicitly links weaker group members to others’ excitement. Broad weak-animal translation avoids unsupported anatomy.

english_summary: The group’s excitement draws even its weaker member along.
